comment: Example rules for scripts/react.py. Try them with --events-from examples/captured-events.txt first, then against a robot as a dry run, then with --act. Rules are matched in order and every matching rule fires.

rules.name: greet a swipe
rules.comment: Stroking the head strip forwards. The release event carries the tap details, so match press to react as it happens. say blocks the event loop for the whole of playback - fine here because a greeting is the whole reaction, but do not put one in a rule meant to keep up with someone.

rules.name: ask for help when tipped over
rules.comment: Any of the fallen motions. A list means any of these values. blink runs until something stops it - period_ms is how fast it flashes, not how long - so the rule turns the LEDs off itself.

rules.name: look up when the screen is touched
